notes: USABLE WITH CAVEATS — conditional. Shah et al. 2023 randomized open-label comparison, clindamycin phosphate 1% gel nightly for 12 weeks; small study, mild baseline lesion burden, attrition to 45 active completers, unspecified brand and vehicle, active minocycline comparator rather than vehicle. Week-3 active mean IL count 4.48 exceeds observed baseline 4.32, so it is a worsening observation and cannot enter a positive-magnitude decrease effect; its raw value remains in sources.md. The fitter uses only weeks 6, 9, 12. The endpoint-only regulatory gel study is separate. No graded skin-side-effect trajectory is available, so simulated side-effect burden will be underestimated.
